text:
maria: Heads-up — seeing a weird client-side stall that debounces heartbeats for ~300ms then triggers reconnects. Spike in resume attempts around 15:02 UTC in EU.

sahil: can you paste logs? is this SSE or WS?

maria: SSE. snippet from edge-proxy logs:
```
[2026-03-22T15:02:14Z] conn=abc123 last_heartbeat=2026-03-22T15:01:59Z debounce_ms=300 resume_attempt=1
[2026-03-22T15:02:14Z] conn=abc123 client_stalled=true
```
client reports no data for ~120ms then sends 1st chunk + close -> reconnect.

katie: @maria does this correlate with console sampling toggles? we recently rolled out dynamic sampling per-route.

maria: yes — toggling sampling for route /v1/stream triggers a flurry. hypothesis: console toggles cause SSE client to enter short poll fallback which our client-side debounce conflates with idle -> triggers reconnect.

john: hmm. routing/affinity might be involved. if console probes swap route weight, clients could see a short pause while backend moves. Are these clients behind proxies (mobile SDK)?

sahil: repro steps request: client connected, console flips sampling flag, backend migrates shard -> client sees packet pause -> debounce decides to reconnect. can we replicate with `wrk` + artificial pause?

maria: repro script attached:
```
# simulate pause
sleep 0.15; echo 'pause' > /dev/null
# client logic: if no bytes for debounce_ms -> reconnect
```
But it's flaky — only when pause ~120-350ms.

katie: fallout: billing duplicates? metric `resume_token_replay` ticked earlier. need to ensure reconnects don't generate duplicate charge.

john: mitigation idea: make resume idempotent server-side (check last-seq) + add server hint header `X-SSE-PROBE` so console toggles don't cause clients to think transport died.

sahil: short-term fix: increase client debounce window from 300ms -> 600ms and add jitter to avoid herd.

maria: agreed — increase to 600ms for canary in EU. will add jitter.

katie: but increasing debounce hurts real-time latency. tradeoff: 600ms means slower detection of real disconnects. maybe make debounce adaptive: if route is marked 'console-probed' widen window.

john: we already annotate routes with probe metadata in routing policy. Could expose `console_probe` label in config and runtime header to clients.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: canary client-debounce=600ms to eu-edge at 2026-03-23T01:00:00Z :robot_face:

sahil: before deploy, need dashboards: add `sse_debounce_events{route}` and last-heartbeat-per-conn gauge. Console UI needs a flag to show 'probe in-progress' to reduce confusion.

maria: added TODO in ticket: https://redwood-inf.atlassian.net/browse/PLAT-1428 — include link to sample trace. @john could you own server-side resume idempotency?

john: I'll take PLAT-1428. I'll also add check: if resume token seen within 5s window ignore replay and emit `resume_replay_ignored` metric.

katie: also alerting: create alert if resume_rate > baseline * 3 AND billing_dup > 0 for 5m.

maria: thanks — will run canary & report back. root cause likely interaction between console probe routing updates and client debounce heuristics.
